inj.note: Beck showed up on the Cardinals' Week 11 injury report Thursday as limited due to back spasms that have flared up, per reporters the team's official site. Beck then didn't practice Friday, but Arizona still is giving him a chance to play Sunday. If Beck isn't able to go, though, Josh Johnson is lined up to be under center in his place.

news.h: Cardinals to start rookie QB Carson Beck against Rams
news.d: The Cardinals will start their third quarterback in three weeks, with rookie Carson Beck getting the nod for Sunday's home game against the Rams.
